findings.note: ESPN's 2026-27 game log shows Portis averaging only 8.3 points on 39.7% shooting so far with Miami, which points to lower offensive volume than in his Milwaukee years.

In the Oct 26 loss to Dallas, Portis went 3-6 from three in 24 minutes off the bench. RotoWire says he keeps struggling from the floor and his role should stay somewhat limited while Giannis and Adebayo are healthy.

Portis is expected to be one of Miami's first players off the bench. Playing next to Giannis and Adebayo could cut his opportunities, though he has shot at least 35% from three in each of his past nine seasons. This search found no game-day injury report or analyst pick for this Heat-Kings game.
